title: Unidentified three-page ciphertext bound among the Medici grand-ducal cipher keys (Governo Mediceo, cifre nos. 1001-1214, item 174)
shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Firenze, 'Governo Mediceo - cifre de' secoli XVII-XVIII dal n. 1001 al n. 1214' (214 cc.), item 174 (DECODE name ASFi_SIIVol6_174)
folio_note: 3 pages; sits between DECODE key records R7396 (item 173) and R7398 (item 175) in the same key volume
status: DECODE R7397 (status N/A, record type ciphertext, 3 pp., cipher type 6, symbol sets 8,3,1, public access; no sender, receiver, date or language entered). Not in the repo (known.py: only the DECODE/Cryptoole dumps; Cryptoole marks it 'na'). The other ciphertext records of the same Mediceo key volumes (R7019, R7021, R7024, R7234) carry a plaintext and are marked solved by Cryptoole; this one has none.
why: A ciphertext filed inside the Medici chancery's own key collection; the neighbouring key sheets (R7396, R7398) are the obvious first keys to try, and a fit would identify the correspondent and date.
score_note: Scored from the DECODE record during the Oct 2026 Medici Archive Project/BIA sweep (research/medici_bia/); not viewed (BIA login-only, ASF offline)
verify: Open DECODE R7397 images; check whether it is a ciphertext or a further key/sample sheet; try the keys R7396 and R7398, then the other ~1,770 Governo Mediceo key records (R5687-R7459).
prior_art: open as far as checked (26 Oct 2026: DECODE record has no plaintext; Cryptoole 'na'; not in repo). No web search, importance below 3.
